description.zh-CN: 统一管理子插件的受控 SSH 采集、命令审计与执行授权，默认停用。
description.en-US: Shared controlled SSH collection, command review and execution approvals; disabled by default.

compatibility.tower: Requires the Rivetin SSH channel broker; live collection compatibility must be verified for each host build.

releaseNotes.zh-CN: 更新为结构化兼容声明，要求 Rivetin 框架 0.2.x 与 CloudTower 4.9.0。保持默认关闭、凭据继承及逐插件人工审核；不新增设备操作或自动执行。
releaseNotes.en-US: Adds structured compatibility metadata for Rivetin framework 0.2.x and CloudTower 4.9.0. Default-off behavior, credential inheritance and per-plugin review are retained; no new device operations or automatic execution.
